grammar.title: സാധ്യതയും നിഗമനവും
grammar.explain: Malayalam uses rich case suffixes, head-final order, participles and non-finite clause chains. Dative subjects encode possession, experience and modality; illa supports negative patterns. Script, gemination, vowel length, retroflex contrasts and spoken-written register all affect meaning.
grammar.pattern: case-marked arguments + participial/adverbial material + auxiliaries + final predicate

കണക്കുകൾ തിരുത്തിയിട്ടുണ്ടാകാം, പക്ഷേ ഒറ്റ രാത്രികൊണ്ട് അവ ഇരട്ടിയായിരിക്കാനാവില്ല.
key: Malayalam uses rich case suffixes, head-final order, participles and non-finite clause chains. Dative subjects encode possession, experience and modality; illa supports negative patterns. Script, gemination, vowel length, retroflex contrasts and spoken-written register all affect meaning.
